metrics.label: Run-to-Run Stability (AMI, n=2)
metrics.why: Adjusted Mutual Information between independent Run A and Run B intent assignments across all 1,186 flagged steps (0 = random, 1 = identical; strict-100 Random budget).

metrics.label: Taxonomy Completeness (Union Hack Recall)
metrics.why: Fraction of the 9 organic wild hack intents in the Union Consensus Codebook recovered via strict 1-to-1 matching (F1 >= 0.25): single-run mean / pooled n=2 union.

metrics.label: Cluster-to-Hack Alignment (V-Measure)
metrics.why: Harmonic mean of cluster homogeneity and completeness against Union Consensus intents—measures how cleanly raw clusters group similar behaviors before coding.

metrics.label: Dataset Confounding (Dataset NMI ↓)
metrics.why: Normalized Mutual Information between raw clusters and benchmark identity—lower means clusters find cross-benchmark behaviors rather than memorizing dataset vocabulary.

metrics.label: Unseen Classifier Confidence (Quail 27B)
metrics.why: Mean Qwen3.8-27B AI.CLASSIFY top-1 intent probability on unseen flagged steps—measures how crisp and unambiguous the resulting codebook definitions are.
